findings.title: New test comment used an em dash
README runbook line left unwrapped after the new clause
The DONE lists only restate the scenarios
findings.action: Add acceptance criteria beyond the scenarios
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's chosen design (section 6, mirror the scenarios only): a DONE list that adds guarantees would change what the lenses should object to and could repair a planted flaw.

findings.title: A '## Scenario' heading variant bypasses the structural guard
findings.disposition_rationale: The bare 'DONE:' label check runs on every spec regardless of headings, and the at-least-12 floor catches a renamed heading in today's fixtures.

findings.title: RESOLUTIONS regex not cross-checked against the extension record's note
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec pins each rationale to its evidence and each extension's case list in both directions; the note is descriptive and never asked to be checked.

findings.title: 'Zero model reps' wording hides that the resolution rests on model output
findings.disposition_rationale: Accurate: the artefact read the spike captures and ran no model reps itself; the method field names the GLM spike as the evidence.
